introduction: Jihye, a call center employee at a delivery application company, is worried about her colleague, Boyoung, who hasn’t been answering her texts since a few days ago. She asks Chowon, another colleague of hers, about Boyoung, but Boyoung doesn’t seem to care about her. They are suffering from power abuse and harassment at work all the time. One day, they go for a drink and have fun trying to relieve their stress. After they get drunk, they decide to experience what it feels like to be in a position of power over others for the first time in their lives. However, they end up making a huge mistake…
